feedback_text: The colleague found my missing parcel and arranged delivery before closing time.
My new jumper stayed soft and kept its shape after several washes.
The cashier noticed I had been overcharged and corrected the bill straight away.
A staff member brought the right shoe size and checked the fit patiently.
The bakery team reserved a fresh loaf for me after I called ahead.
The refund arrived the same afternoon and the returns colleague explained each step.
The wheelchair ramp was clear and the entrance was easy to use.
I found the coat I wanted and the fitting room was clean and spacious.
The store associate helped me compare fabrics without rushing me.
The meal deal was good value and every item was fresh.
My online order was ready on time and all the items were correct.
The team replaced the faulty kettle quickly and kept me updated.
The colleague remembered my earlier query and gave me a useful update.
The queue moved quickly and the staff member was welcoming.
The product matched its description and worked exactly as expected.
A team member helped me find allergy information on the packaging.
The store was tidy and the shelves were easy to browse.
The assistant arranged a delivery slot that suited my schedule.
The manager listened carefully and resolved the billing problem.
The replacement arrived safely and was packed well.
The service was excellent; I only waited forty minutes for someone to notice me.
Brilliant, another parcel marked delivered that never reached my door.
I love being charged twice for one sandwich; what a treat.
Fantastic support: three calls and my refund is still missing.

The staff were so helpful that nobody answered my question all afternoon.
Great, the website cancelled my order without telling me.

Wonderful, the lift is out again and I cannot reach the upper floor.

Lovely experience: the queue was long and only one till was open.

I really love the store experience especially the music being played. The store is playing all the Billboard 100 hits which is fantastic. I feel M&S can plan for theme based music like MJ tributes, Halloween special songs, Christmas songs etc. and it will resonate well with everyone.
